[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系中发现了战略资源：“泽珞”的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的蒸馏泽珞技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。

texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: 'Zro' in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] units with 'psionic' properties, such as the Shroud-Forged. With our Zro Distillation technology, we will be capable of extracting this resource if we control the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.
